Trigger (When It Fires): Automatic (Enhanced Measurement) on every page load.
Key Parameters: page_location, page_title, page_referrer, content_group (wiki | blog | score-guide | product | pricing)

Trigger (When It Fires): Automatic when a new session begins.
Automatic on a user's very first session.
Fires at 25/50/75/90% scroll on content pages.
User clicks a CTA on a content/wiki page (use GA4 select_content).
A promo banner is seen / clicked.
Account registration completes successfully.
Key Parameters: method (email | google | apple | facebook), source_page, referral_code

Trigger (When It Fires): Returning user authenticates.
User clicks the verification link.
Each step of the onboarding wizard is completed.
User finishes the full onboarding flow.
User enters their scheduled CELPIP exam date.
User selects their target CLB level and reason for testing.
Key Parameters: target_clb, purpose (pr | citizenship | work | study | professional)

Trigger (When It Fires): User starts any practice test, module, or quiz.
Key Parameters: test_id, test_type (full_mock | module | quiz), module (listening | reading | writing | speaking), difficulty, is_free, attempt_number

Trigger (When It Fires): Test is submitted and scored.
Key Parameters: test_id, module, duration_sec, raw_score, estimated_clb, questions_attempted, completion_rate

Trigger (When It Fires): User exits a test without submitting (timeout or navigation away).
User returns to a saved in-progress test.
The section timer runs out before submission.
Listening audio clip starts playing.
Listening audio fails to load or play.
User submits a Writing task response.
User submits a recorded Speaking task.
Browser microphone permission is granted or denied.
A Writing/Speaking submission is sent for AI scoring.
AI feedback is successfully delivered to the user.
AI scoring errors, times out, or is rate-limited.
User opens the detailed AI feedback panel.
User rates the AI feedback (thumbs up/down or stars).
User opens their score report.
Key Parameters: overall_clb, listening_clb, reading_clb, writing_clb, speaking_clb, test_id

Trigger (When It Fires): User finishes a vocabulary or flashcard set.
The paywall or upgrade modal is displayed.
Pricing page or plan comparison is viewed.
User picks a plan.
Checkout flow is initiated.
Payment succeeds.
Key Parameters: transaction_id, value, currency (CAD), items, coupon, subscription_term, is_trial_conversion

Trigger (When It Fires): A charge is declined or errors out.
A non-payment error blocks checkout (validation, tax, network).
A discount code is applied or rejected.
A recurring charge succeeds.
User upgrades or downgrades.
User opens the cancellation flow.
User selects or types a cancellation reason.
Cancellation is confirmed.
User requests a refund.
A dormant user (14+ days inactive) returns.
User submits an NPS or CSAT rating.
A JavaScript error or unhandled exception occurs.
Core Web Vitals are measured on page load.
